actions.name: Split a bill privately: agree who owes what, each pays their share on the private rail
actions.summary: The same agreement as evm.split — each debtor signs their own share with their room key, and the creditor agrees by proposing it — settled so the chain names no payer, no payee and no amount: the creditor shares a shielded key node, each debtor pays shielded → shielded from their own LEZ wallet, and the creditor's own scan confirms each share when a note of exactly that amount arrives. Every share is a different amount, a few base units apart, so a note can be attributed to its share without the chain naming anyone.

fields.name: chain
fields.means: the LEZ zone (CAIP-2) every share is paid on — the policy's qualifier (lez-split@<CAIP-2>)

fields.name: total
fields.means: the bill, canonical decimal in base units (9 decimals); the creditor's own share is total minus the shares

fields.name: creditor
fields.means: who fronted the bill and is owed: their room identity

fields.name: payTo
fields.means: the creditor's shielded key node, priv:<npk>:<vpk> — where each private note lands; never a public account

fields.name: shares
fields.means: [{who, amount}] sorted by who, each debtor once, never the creditor, and NO TWO AMOUNTS EQUAL — the amount is how a note is matched to its share

fields.name: quote
fields.means: optional — a bill in another currency (exo-3a4): {currency, fiatTotal in its minor units, fiatDecimals, rateFiat, rateAsset, source, at}; the rate is the proposer's quote, recorded in the log as an external read before anyone agrees ("sources": {"quote": "read"}, invariant 10), and the total must be exactly its conversion

steps.does: Composes the split with their shielded key node as payTo and distinct shares (evenShares(distinctAmounts = true): the i-th debtor owes i base units less, the creditor absorbing them). A public payTo, an asset other than LEZ, or two equal shares is refused with its reason.

steps.who: each debtor the split names, and the creditor
steps.does: Agrees to their own share in-app with their room key, exactly as for evm.split; only a named party's key counts. The creditor's agreement (their word that payTo is theirs) is made when they propose: a private split is proposed only by its creditor, whose shielded key node is not shared in the room (exo-770).
steps.signs: an Ed25519 signature by the debtor's room identity over the split's dCBOR materialization; plus a muster attestation over P

steps.does: Each debtor pays their derived share on the private rail from their OWN LEZ wallet — from the one shielded note that covers it (money received privately, a shield to yourself included, lands at an account the scan discovers; a transfer draws on one note) — and reports it, with the zone's transaction, once the proof lands (minutes). A public source is refused: the shield rail would name the payer and the amount. The creditor's own wallet scans: a note that arrived at payTo, of exactly one share's amount, not already claimed, confirms that share; the room records a hash of the note's id. A report without a note never confirms. Neither side acts on a scan still behind the chain tip; each member's scan keeps moving while a split waits on them.
steps.signs: each debtor's own private LEZ transfer (their wallet proves and signs it); each report is signed by its author's room key

steps.does: Every share confirmed by the creditor's scan (or marked received outside muster): the split is final on every member.

refusals.what: a private split whose payTo is a public account, whose asset is not LEZ, or two of whose shares are equal
refusals.why: the private split pays only a shielded key node, and equal shares could not be told apart by amount

refusals.what: paying a share from a public LEZ account
refusals.why: the shield rail would name the payer and the amount on the chain; a private split takes only the private rail

refusals.what: confirming a share with no note of exactly that amount at payTo
refusals.why: a private payment names no payer: the note is the proof, not the payer's report
the creditor's client refuses a note it already claimed

refusals.what: paying a share no single shielded note of the debtor's covers
refusals.why: a private transfer draws on one note; the debtor is told so, and nothing moves

refusals.what: paying, or matching a note, on a wallet whose scan has not reached the chain tip
refusals.why: a note may sit in a block not yet read: behind is reported as 'still scanning', never as 'nothing arrived'

refusals.what: a bill in fiat whose total is not exactly its quote's conversion, or whose quote was never recorded as a read
refusals.why: the driver refuses the total with the conversion it expected; without the recorded read the quote is an unaccountable input, so no agreement to it counts ('unaccountable-input', invariant 10)

actions.ui: Room → + → Split with "Settles on" the private split: the total in LEZ (9 decimals), who's in, a preview of each share (a few base units apart, so the creditor's scan can tell whose payment arrived) → Propose; the split card → Agree to my share → Pay my share (once everyone agreed; paid privately from your own LEZ wallet) → the creditor's card confirms each share when their scan finds its note ("received — a private note of exactly this share"), or Mark received

claims.claim: The chain learns only that private transfers happened: no payer, no payee, no amount
Each debtor pays from their own shielded account; a public source is refused, never quietly allowed
A share is confirmed only by the creditor's own scan finding a note of exactly that amount — never by the payer's word
No payment is sent and no note matched on a wallet whose scan is behind the chain tip
Nothing makes anyone pay: the room shows who has

A private payment names no zone, but lands only where it was proven: each private input cites a commitment-set root the zone checks against its own history, and a debtor's payment spends their own private account there
A zone that shares this one's commitment history — a fork or a replica — would accept the same transaction
claims.party: a fork or replica of the zone

evidence.what: LEZ v0.2.4: a nullifier is accepted only if the commitment-set root it cites is in this zone's own root history
LEZ v0.2.4: a privacy-preserving message is public actions, nonces, private actions and validity windows — no zone or chain id
